rules.statement: Where, pending a partition action, a co-owner gifts to certain persons the shares to which he will be declared entitled in the action, the interests which are allotted in that action to the donor pass automatically to the donees when the final decree is entered.
rules.supporting_quote: Where, pending a partition action, a co-owner gifts to certain persons the shares to which he will be declared entitled in the action, the interests which are allotted in that action to the donor pass automatically to the donees when the final decree is entered.
